verdict_reason: The MLE local-intrinsic-dimension estimator itself is faithful and stable: on 20 documents of the default corpus, lid_mean and lid_median reproduce to 0.8% and 0.2% under a permutation of the identical document set, and the task is exactly deterministic across repeated identical runs. No defect was found in the estimator on the axes measured.
comparable_reason: lid_max is the least stable summary this task emits, but the effect at the SHIPPED configuration is modest and my first measurement overstated it. At the shipped default num_samples=50, permuting the identical document set moves lid_max 34.584650 -> 33.201389 (4.00%), against lid_mean 1.72% and lid_median 2.14%. The 101.05% swing I first measured (25.357403 -> 50.981638) was at num_samples=20, BELOW this task's shipped default, and is not a statement about any configuration that ships. Mechanism is unchanged: lid.py:88 selects query points BY INDEX under a fixed seed while X concatenates document token vectors IN CORPUS ORDER, so a permutation keeps the indices and changes the points they name; the effect simply shrinks as the query sample grows.
github_reason: Not cross-checked against a released implementation in this pass; the repo carries its own MLE-LID parity coverage. This review measured determinism, order and sample-size behaviour, not reference parity.
confounds_reason: At the shipped num_samples=50 no confound was established: lid_max's 4.00% order sensitivity is of the same order as lid_mean's 1.72% and lid_median's 2.14%, so it does not single lid_max out. Flagged for attention rather than confirmed. Below the shipped sample size the gap widens sharply (101% at N=20), so lid_max should not be used in reduced-sample runs.
defects: COMPARABILITY (bounded), geometry/lid.py:88 + :232: lid_max is the maximum over a seed-fixed random subsample of query INDICES into an order-dependent point array, so its corpus-permutation sensitivity grows as the sample shrinks -- 4.00% at the shipped num_samples=50, 101.05% at num_samples=20. Reported with that bound because a finding without one is not actionable.
fix: No change required at the shipped sample size. If reduced-sample runs are ever used, either draw query points from a corpus-order-independent identifier or report a high quantile (p95) instead of the maximum. Do not change the estimator.
